args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 but
actually used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build failure in
tests/test_money.py. Quantize to cents with ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead.

Examples:
  2.675 -> 2.68 (both modes agree; half up toward even)
  2.665 -> 2.66 (banker's rounding to even cent)

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: quantize to cents with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Behavior
- `2.675 -> 2.68` (rounds to even)
- `2.665 -> 2.66` (rounds to even; previously `2.67`)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.
